AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

4. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

5. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

6. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

7. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

9. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

10. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

11. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

12. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

13. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
